summary: The Colorado Mining Association objected to permit requirements for miners under the proposed ORV regulations, opposing regulations that would adversely affect prospecting and mining on public lands. Their position was part of a broader group of mining industry commenters who sought exemptions for mining vehicles from ORV regulations. The Department ultimately responded by excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles in the final environmental statement.
summary_quote: The Colorado Mining Association objects to regulations currently under consideration. These regulations would have an adverse effect on prospecting for and mining of minerals on public lands.
